provenance.gateway: Workers AI binding through AI Gateway osskb-digest-dev

clients.text: Java consumer with SubscriptionPattern stops refreshing metadata after an assigned topic is deleted (KAFKA-21309, open).
Producer close() hangs indefinitely if the in-flight transaction abort never succeeds (KAFKA-21132, open).
Admin client types for Cluster Mirroring feature are added (KAFKA-PR-23829, closed).

community.text: Flaky Test Report returns 401 error (open, KAFKA-MAIL-0919aafa).

connect.text: Documentation version references updated to 4.4 (KAFKA-PR-23869, merged).
Quickstart command examples made copy-friendly (KAFKA-PR-23526, merged).
Connect REST API return types improved (KAFKA-PR-22001, merged).

group-coordination.text: Assignor offloading for consumer groups would run on a background thread (KAFKA-20292, open).
Group spec copying would use SmallIntegerSet (KAFKA-PR-23871, open).
Client tests would migrate to RebalanceListener (KAFKA-20684, open).

kraft.text: Docker image would support KRaft dynamic quorum controllers
Empty batches in non-atomic batching are avoided
Dynamic configs less than half the value in server.properties may not take effect after restart

observability.text: Client metrics match patterns would use RE2/J syntax (KAFKA-PR-23696, open).
Telemetry reporter would skip disabled sensor metrics (KAFKA-PR-23763, open).
Java client would honor TelemetryMaxBytes limit (KAFKA-PR-23452, open).

releases.text: Release.py stage-docs is fixed for Hugo layout (KAFKA-PR-23833, merged).
Release 4.4.0 is proposed with 26 KIPs (KAFKA-MAIL-1ea662ce, discussing).

security.text: Kafka would support setting TLS named groups (KIP-1376, proposed).
Gradle would be upgraded to 9.8.2 for a security fix (KAFKA-21299, open).
SslTransportLayer.transferFrom bug fix is proposed (KAFKA-21280, open).

share-groups.text: Share group DLQ setup is added to ShareConsumeBenchSpec (KAFKA-PR-23867, merged).
Streams assignments are returned when all owned task sets are reported (KAFKA-PR-23768, merged).

storage.text: Log directory goes offline on disk error (KAFKA-16304, open).
Fetch response sent zero copy, with offline check (KAFKA-16304, open).

streams.text: Rack-aware assignment gets implemented for Streams standby tasks (KAFKA-20999, merged).
Deadlock between removeStreamThread and addStreamThread gets fixed (KAFKA-20873, merged).
Validation of Streams task assignor output is proposed (KAFKA-21170, open).

KIP-1133.text: Release docs 使用 Hugo layout（KAFKA-21289，已解決）

KIP-1241.text: Document for KIP-1241 would be updated (KAFKA-PR-23520, open).

KIP-1314.text: Broker-side consumer group rebalance callback would provide a stable extension point (KAFKA-20402, open).

KIP-1322.text: Kraft gets metrics for fetch and election timeouts (KIP-1322, proposed).

KIP-1324.text: Client configuration observability would be operator-driven (KIP-1324, proposed).

KIP-1332.text: Compression support for KIP-1332 would be implemented (KAFKA-20579, open).

KIP-1376.text: Kafka would support setting TLS named groups (KIP-1376, proposed).

KIP-1381.text: Brokers would disable compression types for client writes (KIP-1381, proposed).

KIP-1382.text: Expose explicit configuration deletions to AlterConfigPolicy (proposed).

KIP-853.text: Docker image would support KRaft dynamic quorum controllers

KIP-891.text: Kafka Connect multiversioning gets config and validation tests (KAFKA-PR-18326, open).

KIP-909.text: Kafka Streams would be made KIP-909 ready

KIP-995.text: Initial offsets can be specified while creating connectors (KAFKA-15976, resolved, KAFKA-PR-23783, merged).

body.text: Kafka would support setting TLS named groups
Gradle would be upgraded to 9.8.2 for a security fix
Kraft gets metrics for fetch and election timeouts

clients: Java 訂閱者在指派主題被刪除後停止刷新元資料 (KAFKA-21309, 仍在進行)。
如果飛行中的事務中止永遠失敗，Producer close() 會無限期掛起 (KAFKA-21132, 仍在進行)。
Cluster Mirroring 功能的 Admin client 類型已新增 (KAFKA-PR-23829, 已合併)。
community: 不穩定測試報告返回 401 錯誤 (仍在進行, KAFKA-MAIL-0919aafa)。
connect: 文件版本參考已更新至 4.4 (KAFKA-PR-23869, 已合併)。
Quickstart 命令範例已改為易複製格式 (KAFKA-PR-23526, 已合併)。
Connect REST API 回傳類型已改善 (KAFKA-PR-22001, 已合併)。
group-coordination: 消費者群組的 Assignor 遷移將在背景執行緒中運行 (KAFKA-20292, 仍在進行)。
群組規格複製將使用 SmallIntegerSet (KAFKA-PR-23871, 仍在進行)。
客戶端測試將遷移至 RebalanceListener (KAFKA-20684, 仍在進行)。
kraft: Docker 映像將支援 KRaft 動態仲裁控制器
非原子批次中的空批次將被避免
動態設定值小於 server.properties 中的一半，重啟後可能不會生效
observability: 客戶端指標匹配模式將使用 RE2/J 語法 (KAFKA-PR-23696, 仍在進行)。
儀表板報告器將跳過停用的感測器指標 (KAFKA-PR-23763, 仍在進行)。
Java 客戶端將遵守 TelemetryMaxBytes 限制 (KAFKA-PR-23452, 仍在進行)。
releases: 釋出 4.3.2 將修復錯誤 (KAFKA-MAIL-e07e6b7f, 正在討論)。
Release.py stage-docs 已修復 Hugo 設計 (KAFKA-PR-23833, 已合併)。
釋出 4.4.0 已提出，包含 26 個 KIP (KAFKA-MAIL-1ea662ce, 正在討論)。
security: Kafka 將支援設定 TLS 命名群組（KIP-1376，已提出）。
Gradle 將升級至 9.8.2 以修復安全性問題 (KAFKA-21299, 仍在進行)。
SslTransportLayer.transferFrom 的錯誤修復已提出 (KAFKA-21280, 仍在進行)。
share-groups: Share group DLQ 設定已新增至 ShareConsumeBenchSpec (KAFKA-PR-23867, 已合併)。
當所有擁有任務集報告後，Streams 指派將被回傳 (KAFKA-PR-23768, 已合併)。
storage: 磁碟錯誤時日誌目錄將離線 (KAFKA-16304, 仍在進行)。
取得回應時會以零複製方式傳送，並進行離線檢查 (KAFKA-16304, 仍在進行)。
streams: Streams 備用任務的機架感知指派功能已實現 (KAFKA-20999, 已合併)。
removeStreamThread 與 addStreamThread 之間的死結已修復 (KAFKA-20873, 已合併)。
Streams 任務指派器輸出的驗證已提出 (KAFKA-21170, 仍在進行)。

proposals.KIP-1133: Release docs 使用 Hugo layout（KAFKA-21289，已解決）
proposals.KIP-1241: KIP-1241 的文件將被更新 (KAFKA-PR-23520, 仍在進行)。
proposals.KIP-1314: 代理端消費者群組重新平衡回呼將提供穩定的擴展點 (KAFKA-20402, 仍在進行)。
proposals.KIP-1322: Kraft 將新增取得與選舉超時的指標 (KIP-1322, 已提出)。
proposals.KIP-1324: 客戶端設定可觀察性將由操作員驅動 (KIP-1324, 已提出)。
proposals.KIP-1332: 將實現 KIP-1332 的壓縮支援 (KAFKA-20579, 仍在進行)。
proposals.KIP-1374: StreamsBuilder.globalTable 將允許重新設定金鑰（KIP-1374，已提出）
proposals.KIP-1376: Kafka 將支援設定 TLS 命名群組（KIP-1376，已提出）。
proposals.KIP-1381: 代理將禁用客戶端寫入的壓縮類型 (KIP-1381, 已提出)。
proposals.KIP-1382: 將顯式設定刪除功能暴露給 AlterConfigPolicy (已提出)。
proposals.KIP-853: Docker 映像將支援 KRaft 動態仲裁控制器
proposals.KIP-891: Kafka Connect 多版本功能將新增設定與驗證測試 (KAFKA-PR-18326, 仍在進行)。
proposals.KIP-909: Kafka 將被改為 KIP-909 就緒
proposals.KIP-939: 交易協調器將支援 keepPreparedTxn=true (KAFKA-15370, 仍在進行)。
proposals.KIP-995: 建立連接器時可指定初始偏移量 (KAFKA-15976, 已解決, KAFKA-PR-23783, 已合併)。
